exercises.name: Jump Lunges
exercises.notes: NASM lists Primary: Quadriceps, Glutes. Secondary: Hamstrings, Hip Stabilizers, Core Stabilizers, Calf Muscles. Hip and core stabilizers are left out because wger's 15 muscles have no exact match for them. NASM names no equipment; it is a bodyweight move. NASM's page links a YouTube video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_5kDxC0flg0
